name: Forbidden Island

setup.text: Shuffle the 24 island tiles and lay them face up in a pattern: a 4 by 4 square, then 2 more tiles against each of the 2 middle tiles on every side. Leave small gaps.
Put the 4 treasure figurines around the island.
Split the cards into the Flood deck (blue back), Treasure deck (red back) and the 6 Adventurer cards.
Shuffle the Flood deck. Draw 6 cards one at a time into a discard pile, flipping each matching tile to its flooded side.
Place the Water Level marker on the Water Meter at the difficulty you want. Novice is advised for a first co-operative game.
Draw 1 Adventurer card at random and read your power aloud.
Put the pawn of your colour on the tile showing its icon. Starting on a flooded tile is fine.
Deal 2 Treasure cards face up. Swap any Waters Rise! card for a new one, then shuffle it back into the Treasure deck.
The player who most recently visited an island goes first. Play passes left.

turn.summary: Take up to 3 actions, draw 2 Treasure cards, then draw Flood cards equal to the water level.
steps: Spend up to 3 actions on any mix of: move, shore up, give a Treasure card, capture a treasure.
Move to an adjacent tile (not diagonal), or shore up an adjacent tile or your own by flipping it back over.
Give a Treasure card to someone on your tile for 1 action per card. Special Action cards cannot be given.
Capture a treasure for 1 action by discarding 4 matching Treasure cards while on either of its two tiles.
Draw 2 Treasure cards one at a time. Waters Rise! cards are resolved straight away and not kept.
Draw Flood cards equal to the water level. Flip a tile if it is dry. Remove it from the game if it is already flooded.

round_end: Waters Rise!: move the marker up one mark, shuffle the Flood discard pile and put it on top of the Flood draw pile, then discard the card.
end: You win together by holding all 4 treasures, getting every pawn to Fools' Landing, then discarding a Helicopter Lift card. You lose if both tiles for an uncollected treasure sink, Fools' Landing sinks, a pawn has no tile to swim to, or the water level reaches the skull.

scoring.text: No points. The team wins or loses together.

missed.text: Special Action cards (Helicopter Lift, Sandbags) cost no action and can be played at any time, even on another player's turn.
If you must discard down to 5 cards, you can still use a Special Action card before discarding it.
You cannot play Sandbags to save a tile after its Flood card has been revealed.
A Waters Rise! card gives no replacement card. If you draw two in a row, shuffle the Flood discard pile once but move the marker up twice.
You can capture a treasure while on a flooded tile, and you can win from a flooded Fools' Landing.
A pawn on a tile that sinks must swim to an adjacent tile, even a flooded one. If it cannot, everyone loses.
When the Flood draw pile runs out, shuffle its discard pile into a new draw pile and keep drawing. Do the same for the Treasure deck.

not_covered: Adventurer powers beyond the movement and shoring exceptions listed in the turn steps.
unverified: Starting Water Meter setting for each difficulty (Novice, Normal, Elite, Legendary) and the number of Flood cards drawn at each level are printed on the meter, not in the text.
